title: IGNITE: Immune Genomics and fuNctional Integration for Target Enrichment
description: Code and data accompanying the manuscript "Genome-scale perturbation signatures from primary human CD4+ T cells improve genetics-based prioritization of immune drug targets". A positive-unlabeled learning model that ranks immune drug-target candidates across 19,502 genes and 24 features, integrating rare- and common-variant genetic evidence and evolutionary constraint with perturbational functional genomics from genome-scale CRISPRi perturb-seq in primary human CD4+ T cells.
